faqs.q: Is renting a car cheaper than owning one for a business?
faqs.a: It often is when cars are needed only some of the time. Renting avoids paying for insurance, servicing, repairs, parking and vehicles that sit idle, and turns transport into a predictable cost. If a company uses the same cars heavily every day, owning or leasing may work out cheaper, so compare your actual usage first.

faqs.q: What is the difference between business car rental and car leasing?
faqs.a: Business car rental is usually short-term and on demand, by the trip, day or month, so you use a car only when needed. Leasing is a longer contract, typically lasting years, where the company has a fixed vehicle for regular use in exchange for monthly payments. Rental gives more flexibility, while leasing suits steady, daily needs.

faqs.q: Do business car rentals in India come with a driver?
faqs.a: Most corporate car rental services in Indian cities offer chauffeur-driven cars, so the provider handles the driver along with the vehicle. Some also offer self-drive options. Check whether driver allowances, tolls, parking and fuel are included in the quoted price.

faqs.q: What should a company check before choosing a business car rental service?
faqs.a: Check how punctual and reliable the service is, the condition and range of vehicles, how drivers are verified, and whether pricing is clear with no hidden charges. It also helps to confirm valid commercial permits and insurance, backup vehicles for breakdowns, and proper invoices for your accounts.
